newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKERS EXTEND WEEK-LONG RALLY.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKERS EXTEND WEEK-LONG RALLY.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices extended its week-long rally on tight supplies and steady enquiries from shippers, traders said.
They said bunker supplies were offered at about a dollar more than Wednesday with 380-cst sellers at $107/$108 per tonne while 180-cst was offered at around $110-112.
"The enquiries are quiet heavy. The prompt supplies are very tight and ship owners are paying a heavy premium for bunkers loading within the next few days," one major said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated around $170 and $180 per tonne respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3093)
